title: Weak signature digest
message: A digital signature uses SHA-1 or MD5.
remediation: Use an appropriate signature algorithm with a modern digest.

title: Legacy signature verification requires review
message: Signature verification accepts SHA-1 or MD5. Review live protocol acceptance separately from historical-signature compatibility.
remediation: Disable legacy algorithms in new protocol negotiations; review historical verification requirements before migration.

title: Insufficient asymmetric parameter strength
message: The RSA, DSA or DH parameters are below the configured minimum strength.
remediation: Use RSA keys of at least 2048 bits or a modern signature algorithm with adequate strength.

title: Weak hash
message: A deprecated hash algorithm is used in a security-sensitive context.
remediation: Use SHA-256 or a stronger approved hash for security-sensitive hashing.

title: Password hashed without KDF
message: Password-like input is passed directly to a hash operation.
remediation: Use a password KDF such as PBKDF2, scrypt, Argon2, or bcrypt.
